Kheṭakagotrapravaranirṇaya
Kuladevatāsahita (?) Dāhilakṣmī XXXV. 20.

Kheṭakanandana
śaiva writer. a name of Sadyojyotis.
See below Kheṭapāla.

Kheṭakarma
jy. acc. to Sūryasiddhānta by Dāmodara. IM. 5356 (inc.). [Page189-a.

Kheṭakarma
or brahma(siddhAnta)tulya jy. a name of the Karaṇakutūhala of Bhāskara. Bhau Dāji 5.
See NCC. III. p. 172b, Karaṇakutūhala.

Kheṭakutūhala,_Khe._Kautūhala
jy. by Sūrajit, son of Siṁhajit an. grandson of Dāmodara. B. IV. 120. Bikaner 4497 (1626 A. D.).

Kheṭakṛti
jy. Ānandāśrama 1890. Harshe p. 43.

Kheṭakṛti
jy. in 364 verses. composed in 1810 A. D. by Rāghava alias Appājipanta Khāṇḍekara, resident of Pārolā, to the south of Tāpī.
BBRAS. 227. Bhau Dāji 34. Ujjain II. p. 44 (2 mss.).
See NCC. II. p. 142a; 1800 A. D. there is to be corrected a. 1810.
Pt.. Poona, 1889. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1897, p. 39; 1938, p. 1349.

Kheṭakautuka
jy. Skt.-Persian, 99 verses; by Khān Khān Abdur Rahīm. CPB. 1132 (a..).
See also above under a.; also B. C. Law Vol. II. p. 182 fn. 4.
Pt.. (1) with Hindi C. Haridās Skt. Ser. 166. (2) with Hindi transl. Lucknow, 1899. (3) Bombay, 1902. (4) Sitaram Press, Benares, 1928. (5) Bhargabhusan Press, Benares, 1929. (6) Veṅk. Press, Bombay, 1936-37. (7) with Eng. transl. an. notes, J. B. Chaudhury, p.. 33-51, 126-48, Khan-i-Khanan an. Skt. Learning, Calcutta. 1954.

Kheṭacintāmaṇi
jy. B. IV. 120.

Kheṭatantra(gaṇita)
jy. identity of text not known. MD. 13406 (with Telugu meaning) (dates given 1747-1807 A. D.). Mysore I. p. 322. Pannalal Bombay V. p. 20.
See next. [Page189-b]
--C. Uddhāra by Tāṇḍava Kṛṣṇamācārya. Mysore II. p. 16.
--by Nandisūri, son of Devanācārya. MD. 13405 (with Telugu meaning). Trav. Uni. 2479C. 2481D. 2419Z-13.

Kheṭataraṅgiṇī
jy. Jodiya II. 61.
--by Raghunātha. B. IV. 120 (2 mss.).

Kheṭapañcāṅga
jy. Bik. 673. PUL. II. p. 213 (2 mss.; 1 inc.).

Kheṭapāla
also kheTakanandana a name of the śaiva writer Sadyojyotis. Khe. nandana a. a. of Mokṣakārikā is q. by Nārāyaṇakaṇṭha in his Mṛgendravṛtti, Kas. Texts 50. p. 69; also p.. 185, 260; the Āryā q. here identified by Ed.. a. from Tattvasaṁgraha; on p. 212 an. p. 255 (q. from Bhogakārikā).
As Kheṭapāla an. Kheṭapālācārya, he is q. in Somānanda's Śivaḍṛṣti a. having written a C. on Svāyambhuvāgama (III. 13-14. 64, Kas. Texts 54).
Also q. by Abhinavagupta in his Tantrāloka, Vol. VI (Kas. Texts 29. p. 211) where Jayaratha explains in the C. that Kheṭapāla is Sadyojyotis.
Q. also by Kṣemarāja in his C. on Svacchandatantra (Kas. Texts 44, p.. 84, 99).

Kheṭapīṭhamālā
jy. by Āpadeva (ºBhaṭṭa).
See below Grahapīṭhamālā.

Kheṭaplava
jy. by Josīrāya (Jyotiṣarāja) Vīrasiṁhagaṇaka, of Kheṭa on the banks of the Godāvarī in Mahārāṣṭra; son of Kāśīrāja an. Bhāgīrathī an. grandson of Bopadeva; patronised by King Anūpasiṁha of Bikaner; said to have been composed in 15 days when a. was 12 years old; the Bikaner ms. [Page190-a. 4498 was presented by father Kāśīrāja to King Anūpasiṁha in 1675 A. D.
See K. Madhava Krishna Sarma. Adyar Library Bulletin IX. p.. 7-12; also NCC. IV. p. 139a.
Bik. 674. Bikaner 4498-4499 (inc.). 4500 (Grahamadhyamādhikāra alone). 4501 (inc.).

Kheṭabodha
jy. by Koṇeri. B. IV. 120.

Kheṭabhūṣaṇa
jy. by Rāmacandra. B. IV. 120 (2 mss.).

Kheṭamālā
jy. Mandlik p. 77, BM. 29.

Kheṭamuktāvalī

Kheṭasiddhāntasāraṇī

Kheṭa(ka)siddhi,_Laghu
jy. composed in 1578 A. D. by Dinakara, great grandson of Dunda (?) of the Kauśika gotra an. Modha family of the village Bārejya on the Brahmamatī. B. IV. 122 (2 mss.). Bhr. 303. Bikaner 4503. BORI. 303 of 1882-83. D. p. 267 (no. 303). IO. 2947. Oudh IV. 13.

Kheṭasiddhi
